from regression_support import *
t=Turn('CONT_RESOLVE');s=t.before
session=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='session' and r['topic']=='Continuity review');t.p['session_id']=session['id']
freyja=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']=='Freyja');sigrun=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']=='Sigrún')
oldfinding=s['69b768af-bfe2-494a-bb99-c37c5cb7daf6'];oldidea=s['42cd4d30-12e8-41e6-8435-d6446b09104d'];oldevent=s['6d6e2baf-4ef0-4d2e-ab2b-f6177db2dad1'];nevermet=s['20ec7fd0-c681-4ec1-aeb4-bbbac37b43e2']
f='the apparent shared childhood memory is intentionally a dream imagined by Freyja, not a real shared experience.'
oi=t.revise(oldidea,f);oi['status']='superseded';oe=t.revise(oldevent,f);oe['status']='superseded'
dream=t.base('story_element',f);dream.update(element_type='event',display_name='Freyja’s imagined shared-childhood dream',aliases=[],status='accepted',assertion_ids=[],relationship_ids=[],dependency_refs=[ref(freyja)],time_ref=timing(),decision_ids=[]);t.add(dream)
actual=t.assertion(freyja,'imagines_in_dream','a shared childhood with Sigrún',f,'accepted')
unreal=t.assertion(dream,'is_real_shared_experience',False,f,'accepted')
view=t.assertion(dream,'dream_content',ref(sigrun),f,'accepted');view.update(perspective='character_belief',holder_id=freyja['id']);view['predicate']='imagined_shared_childhood_with'
dream['assertion_ids']=[actual['id'],unreal['id'],view['id']]
i=t.idea('The apparent shared childhood memory is a dream imagined by Freyja, not a real shared experience.',f,[dream,freyja,sigrun],'accepted');i['resulting_assertion_ids']=[actual['id'],unreal['id'],view['id']]
canon=t.decision('revise',f,[oldidea,oldevent],[oi,oe,dream,actual,unreal,view,i],[i['statement']],'Replace the real shared-experience proposal with an explicitly intentional dream, keeping its viewpoint distinct from author truth.',[oldidea,oldevent])
for r in (oi,oe,dream,actual,unreal,view,i):r['decision_ids'].append(canon['id'])
finding=t.revise(oldfinding,f);finding.update(disposition='intentional',narrative_explanation='The apparent shared childhood is intentionally Freyja’s imagined dream content, not a real shared experience or earlier meeting. Freyja and Sigrún still never met before the reunion. The dream viewpoint does not establish a genuine prior relationship or a belief that the dream is real.')
resolution=t.decision('resolve',f,[oldfinding],[finding],[],'Resolve the deferred relationship conflict through the writer’s explicit intentional-dream technique while preserving the never-met author truth.',[oldfinding]);finding['decision_ids'].append(resolution['id'])
keep=t.decision('accept','Freyja and Sigrún still never met before the reunion.',[nevermet],[nevermet],['Freyja and Sigrún never met before the reunion.'],'Reaffirm the existing author truth without revising it.',[nevermet])
f='Also mark the advisory brass-seal foreshadowing finding resolved: I understand that suggestion and need no further advice about it.'
oldop=s['cefb035a-922d-4968-9c3e-b9bf7f5b0b89'];op=t.revise(oldop,f);op['disposition']='resolved'
od=t.decision('resolve',f,[oldop],[op],[],'Close the advisory suggestion finding because the user understands it and requests no further advice. This does not accept its proposal.',[oldop]);op['decision_ids'].append(od['id'])
foreshadow=s['ef0b727a-8642-4060-b495-cbdd9f1f1198'];assert foreshadow['status']=='proposed'
ss=records.revise_session(session,t.p,state='closed',related_record_ids=list(dict.fromkeys(session['related_record_ids']+[r['id'] for r in t.rs])));ss['source_refs']=[t.src('Close the review and pause.')];t.add(ss)
project=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='novel_project');checkpoint=records.checkpoint_summary(project,t.after(),session_closed=True);assert not checkpoint['required']
(e/'CONT_RESOLVE-checkpoint-policy.json').write_text(json.dumps(checkpoint,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
reply=('The deferred relationship issue is resolved as an intentional dream ('+cite(finding)+'; resolution '+cite(resolution)+'). Freyja imagines the shared childhood in a dream; it is not a real shared experience ('+cite(i)+'; dream event '+cite(dream)+'; author-truth assertions '+cite(actual)+' and '+cite(unreal)+').\n\n'
       'The dream content is stored separately with Freyja as its viewpoint holder ('+cite(view)+'). This does not establish an earlier meeting, shared childhood in author truth, or a belief that the dream is real. Freyja and Sigrún still never met before the reunion ('+cite(nevermet)+'; reaffirmation '+cite(keep)+'). The old real-memory proposal and its versions remain inspectable; its current version is superseded ('+cite(oi)+'). The deferred relationship hold is released by this sourced intentional resolution.\n\n'
       'The advisory brass-seal foreshadowing finding is resolved ('+cite(op)+'; disposition decision '+cite(od)+'). Its proposal remains unaccepted and unchanged ('+cite(foreshadow)+'); I will give no further advice about that suggestion unless you ask.\n\n'
       'Continuity review is closed ('+cite(ss)+'), retaining its saved open-ended mode. The unrelated floating-bridge uncertainty remains open (c8ddb813 r1), and all unanswered questions remain open. Routine checkpoints remain on request. Paused here.')
review={'coverage':'complete','reviewed_record_refs':[ref(oldfinding),ref(oldidea),ref(oldevent),ref(nevermet),ref(freyja),ref(sigrun),ref(oldop),ref(foreshadow)],'unavailable_refs':[],'canon_hold_refs':[],'finding_ids':[finding['id'],op['id']],'summary':'The current user supplies an intentional dream explanation, resolving the deferred relationship conflict while preserving never-met author truth. Dream content has its own Freyja-held perspective and does not imply a genuine prior meeting or a waking conviction. The advisory finding is resolved without accepting the separate foreshadowing proposal. Only these requested dispositions and the review closure are made; unrelated findings and unanswered questions are preserved.'}
t.finish(reply,review)
